sentences_to_rerecord: So, basically, because there are two brands…

accuracy.anchor: Brands, capability and a (weak) proof were named; the cost and the refused action were never stated (anchor: 17–21 = three of five points, proof stated as a command).

structure.anchor: Four parts present but approach and evidence weak; the framing front-loaded three "because" clauses before the headline (anchor: 14–17 = all parts findable, order broken once).

customer_relevance.anchor: One number (400 orders) and it was hedged; the deadline change was absorbed in one line (anchor: 10–13 = one number, hedged).

brevity_and_fluency.anchor: Framing and update over target, objection 1 well under; six fillers in 7.2 minutes, one tag question, one 11-second pause (anchor: 7–9 = two segments off target, fillers around 1/min).

recovery.anchor: Objection answers acknowledged and offered but skipped the evidence step; the "how many orders" interruption produced a hedge (anchor: 5–6 = pattern partly held).

stems: "The first task is X. It costs you Y. Here is the proof." — headline first, reasons second.
"It costs you… per week" — put one number on the problem before naming the fix.
"What I will not do this week is…" — name the constraint you are respecting.
previous_run_comparison: First recorded run for dryrun on lab 00; no previous run to compare with.
